faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar XJ 3.0d use?
faqLeft.a: The XJ 3.0d uses the AJD-V6 — a 3.0-litre V6 diesel engine, Ford-sourced with twin-turbocharging. It was fitted throughout the X351 generation from 2009 to 2019.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar XJ 3.0d engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,600. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my XJ 3.0d?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact specification before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJD-V6 XJ 3.0d engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We rebuild the AJD-V6 engine to the same high standard as every other Jaguar engine we cover, replacing worn components as standard.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used XJ 3.0d engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my XJ 3.0d if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an XJ 3.0d engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most XJ 3.0d owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
